entities.name: Boris Devilboon
entities.description: Fawning wizard minion of Ramses Overdark who made flame creatures and predicted the future in rhyming verse; killed, resurrected undead, then destroyed.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Imperial assassin who employed Boris and killed and resurrected him.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Man who sought vengeance on Overdark and destroyed his minions.

entities.name: little friends
entities.description: Tiny fire creatures Boris summoned, later made of rotting flesh, tar and offal.

events.summary: Overdark, annoyed by Boris's inaccurate predictions, kills him and then resurrects him as an undead with improved abilities.
events.quote: Overdark was annoyed by the inaccuracy of Boris's predictions and killed him, then resurrected him

events.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa seeks vengeance on Overdark and kills the assassin's minions in his way.
events.quote: Tetsuo Umezawa wanted vengeance from Overdark and killed all the assassin's minions that stood in his way

events.summary: Boris summons an army of undead little friends, but Tetsuo destroys his undead form and dispels them.
events.quote: Tetsuo destroyed his undead form, dispelling his summonings as well.

relations.quote: He followed Ramses loyally, even though the assassin treated him poorly.
Tetsuo destroyed his undead form, dispelling his summonings as well.
